subject: prd/impl-review
statement: For every review process, the reviewer shall append immutable git event records that losslessly implement the parent contract's canonical routing-resolution, routing-failure, routed-attempt-outcome, review-process, and invalidation schemas; the linked proposal payload shall project the frozen demand origin, planned assurance, actual band, effective depth, required pass count, exact reviewed revision, selected review harness and policy version, per-pass attempt/context/native-profile identities and resolution/outcome terminals, internal remediation rounds, per-pass verdicts/findings, and one aggregate terminal, with no prompt or code payload in either face.
rationale: the universal floor, route execution, and critical independence need durable reconstructable evidence rather than editable medium or session claims
fit_criterion: every route links to exactly one canonical resolution or failure; every resolved route links to exactly one `verified`, `failed`, or `blocked` outcome and every failed resolution to none; the parent and proposal faces round-trip losslessly on both tracker media; reruns append and never overwrite; context identities are distinct; payload inspection finds no prompt/code content
